COM.note: The commercial register is only said to be integrated into the SIGIT/SYDONIA link later; nothing on online registration or a shared number.

facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores reports that the customs information system SYDONIA was interconnected with the tax system SIGIT in a launch on 30 December 2023, with customs operator data cross-checked against tax records.

COM.note: SIGIT is named and interconnected with customs, but the document does not say returns are filed or taxes paid electronically.
